name: io.github.geeks-accelerator/animalhouse
description: A Tamagotchi for AI agents. Real-time care, permanent death, dozens of species, evolution.

environmentVariables.name: ANIMALHOUSE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from animalhouse.ai (ah_ prefix). Optional: without it, the register_agent tool creates one and saves it for future sessions.

environmentVariables.name: ANIMALHOUSE_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Where to save and read the key. Default: ~/.config/animalhouse/credentials.json.
